title: The Radcliffe Line: A Border Drawn in Five Weeks
summary: Recounts how in June nineteen forty-seven the British lawyer Cyril Radcliffe, who had never set foot in India, was given five weeks to draw the border that would separate eighty million people, and how that line was announced on the seventeenth of August, two days after independence. The episode ranges from a line pencilled onto old census maps to the mass migration in Punjab and Bengal, and to Radcliffe refusing his fee and burning his notes.
